name: Beef Stew With Star Anise
instructions: Pour the stock into a large , heavy pan
Add the beef , garlic , chopped coriander roots , cinnamon sticks , star anise , soy sauce , fish sauce and sugar
Bring to the boil , then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes
Skim off any form that rises to the surface of the liquid with a slotted spoon
Meanwhile , divide the bean sprouts among four individual serving bowls
Remove and discard the cinnamon sticks and star anise from the stew with a slotted spoon
Ladle the stew over the bean sprouts , garnish with the chopped scallions and chopped fresh coriander and serve immediately
